property_summary: For any admissible sell, c's virtualBaseTokenReserves must strictly decrease by the quote's gross output amount (fees zeroed here), so after any successful sell c.virtualBaseTokenReserves() < the pre-sell value; the mutant leaves virtualBaseTokenReserves unchanged on sell, violating this for any sell with positive output.
change_summary: Delete the statement that decreases virtualBaseTokenReserves during sell, so it stays unchanged after a sell.
